text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday!! Is there anything I can 
help you with?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you. But just having you 
celebrate with me is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay!! I owe you way too much, 
Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like when I was carrying documents and she 
took half of them for me! And during dance 
practice, she even gave me tips on reading 
sheet music!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You really saved me back then!! So at 
least for today, please let me help you 
out instead!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, so I really was able to help. Just 
knowing that is already the best present 
ever, but... hmm, helping out, huh...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Then, will you teach me the duties of 
the Disciplinary Committee?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Won't that just end up with you 
helping me out all over again, though?!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because being able to help someone makes 
me happy. To me, that's a wonderful 
present in itself.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, please. Of course, it doesn't have to 
be right away today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see!! In that case, just leave it all to 
me-ssu!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! Helping, being helped, 
and helping again... It feels like a chain 
connecting us all, and that makes me 
happy.
